intro.title: Build breadcrumb generator from route tree
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a breadcrumb generator that takes a route tree object and returns a list of breadcrumb links. You will learn how to traverse nested data structures using recursion, a core programming concept where a function calls itself. The main technologies involved are JavaScript objects, arrays, and recursive functions. By the end, you'll have a working function that can generate breadcrumb paths from any given route tree.
intro.usecase: Breadcrumb generators are essential navigation patterns in complex web applications like e-commerce platforms, content management systems, and enterprise dashboards. When users navigate through multi-level product categories on Amazon or drill down into nested folders in Google Drive, breadcrumbs provide clear location context and one-click access to parent levels. Developers implement this pattern to transform hierarchical route data into visual trails that improve user orientation and reduce navigation friction. This skill is particularly valuable when building admin panels, documentation sites, or any application with deeply nested content structures.
